root_owned_changes_requested.change: R1: append `# Required by rules_js for pnpm 11 (S3 bazel_full //site); an empty map allows no build scripts.` and `allowBuilds: {}` after `verifyDepsBeforeRun: error`
root_owned_changes_requested.why: rules_js 3.5.1 refuses a pnpm 11 lock without allowBuilds and fails the whole npm extension; an empty map allows no lifecycle scripts
rules_js links the lock's file:vendor/<dir> dependencies to //site/vendor/<dir>:pkg; only the theme's own test package must stay ignored

root_owned_changes_requested.change: R3: delete `common --ignore_dev_dependency` and `common --deleted_packages=site` (the site gate lines)
root_owned_changes_requested.why: test_bazel_graph_s3 requires the gate while R1 or R2 is missing and fails after R1+R2 until these lines go

root_owned_changes_requested.change: R4: add the non-blocking `bazel` job with 83 Python modules, 5 Rust tests, //web:svelte_check_test and //site:svelte_check_test after R1-R3 = 89-90 targets; timeout-minutes 90, continue-on-error
root_owned_changes_requested.why: Hosted Bazel coverage; expected runtime cold 30-50 min, warm 15-25 min

root_owned_changes_requested.change: R6: add `guarded_parts(value)` and use it instead of `value.split('/')` in hidden/staging/traversal guards for apply_capture_profile, arrangement_reference and calibration evaluator fields
root_owned_changes_requested.why: The guard rejects any path component starting with '.', so every checkout under .local/ fails 8 known dot_path_component cases (product_defect)

must_fix: Merging into current main breaks the structural test and hosted CI. Since the merge-base (549a14d), main has added tests/test_take_intake.py and tests/test_timing_calibration.py, so main now has 100 modules. Overlaying the lane's changed files on git archive main in /tmp and running PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest test_bazel_graph_s3 results in FAILED (failures=1) in test_classification_supplement_covers_the_added_modules_with_reasons, with 'supplement module_count_at_supplement 98 != 100 modules'. Fix: rebase onto main, classify both modules with reasons in bazel/test_classification_s3_full.json, set module_count_at_supplement to 100, update the tests/BUILD.bazel lists, and update the counts in the receipts (98 to 100).
